race.comment: BEYOND MYSTI (1) made an encouraging return from a 20-week spell last start, beaten just 1.4 lengths in a BM64. Lightly raced mare who should enjoy the perfect run out of the inside draw. Has her share of weight but looks the testing material. SICILIAN PRINCESS (3) has not raced since finishing down the track in a $105k three-year-old race at Murray Bridge in June. Performed well in some strong form races last prep. Good fresh performer who should be up for this. MACHRIMORE (6) led from the outset and towelled up a maiden field over this distance at Halidon when fresh from a spell recently. Sparingly raced four-year-old mare who can go on to better things this campaign. DAZELLES (5) had been knocking on the door before recording an emphatic win last time out over 1300m at Penola. Harder this time but she will go forward and give herself every chance. KORATORA (8) doesn't win out of turn but recent efforts have been sound. Each-way shout.
